title: Crabstar
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Crabstar”, a luxury 6-bed, 6.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Elevator - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Adult Bicycles Included - Short Walk to the Beach Experience coastal living at its finest at Crabstar, a brand-new luxury estate nestled in the heart of Inlet Beach, Florida. Just steps from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf and situated along iconic 30A, this meticulously designed home is a coastal sanctuary where refined design meets laid-back elegance. This three-story retreat features 6 bedrooms, 6.5 bathrooms, and was thoughtfully designed to comfortably accommodate large families or groups while offering privacy, comfort, and style throughout. The open-concept main floor showcases a stunning chef’s kitchen complete with natural shaker cabinetry, Calacatta Ultra quartz countertops, and Thermador appliances, flowing seamlessly into a spacious dining and living area with custom trim, accent walls, and elegant lighting. The expansive porches and outdoor areas offer the perfect backdrop for morning coffee or evening cocktails, while the private heated pool and fenced yard provide resort-style amenities just steps from your door. Each floor features ensuite bedrooms with spa-like bathrooms, including three luxurious master suites adorned with quartz vanities, rainfall showers, and soaking tubs. Custom bunk rooms and dual laundry rooms make family travel easy, while high-end finishes like brilliant white shaker cabinetry, chrome fixtures, and designer lighting elevate every space. Additional highlights include an elevator, wet bar with beverage fridge, multiple covered porches, private garage, and curated interiors by Home and Harmony. Whether you're here to relax poolside, explore 30A’s dining and shops, or spend your days on the beach, Crabstar is your unforgettable home base. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Queen and Twin Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only Second Floor Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo 2 Twin over Twin and 1 Twin over Queen Bunkroom, Private Bathroom, Shower Only Third Floor Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate 1/2 Bathroom
